questions.question: What is the virtual DOM in React?
questions.answer: The virtual DOM is a lightweight representation of the real DOM. React uses it to identify changes and update the necessary parts of the user interface.

questions.question: What is the difference between GET and POST requests?
questions.answer: GET is generally used to retrieve information from a server. POST is used to submit data to the server, such as when creating a new record.

questions.question: How would you handle a form submission error in React?
questions.answer: I would validate the form before submitting it. I would send the data to the backend and check the response. If an error occurs, I would display a meaningful message to the user and allow them to correct the input.
